review_standard: Focused cross-check of latest official 10-K/10-Q and selected notes; not an independent audit, no complete financial footnote reconciliation or verified target price
monitoring_policy: Rebuild from newest SEC XBRL on every scheduled run. If a new filing is published after a reviewed report, flag source as superseded and block 'current' claims until reviewed. Never silently inherit a review conclusion.

evidence.location: MD&A Cash Flows and Other Planned Uses of Capital
evidence.fact: FY2026 CFO $182.935bn; additions to property/equipment $115.948bn; management expects continued investment in datacenters, cloud and AI infrastructure
evidence.impact: CFO-CAPEX ~$66.987bn; cash demand and finance leases require long-run maintenance/growth breakdown

evidence.location: Note 17 — Employee Stock and Savings Plans
evidence.fact: FY2026 SBC expense $12.405bn, 78m nonvested stock awards at 2026-06-30, $24.8bn unrecognized award expense
evidence.impact: Expense and issuance/re-purchases need reconciliation; unvested awards are NOT simply additive one-for-one to all share classes

evidence.location: Liquidity and Capital Resources / debt and leases notes
evidence.fact: Cash, equivalents and short-term investments $76.843bn at 2026-06-30; significant datacenter leases and capacity investment
evidence.impact: Do not add all cash to shareholder DCF or assume lease-financed servers already included in cash CAPEX

MSFT.business_quality: Very high reported profit and cash generation; Azure and AI demand support a strong franchise, subject to infrastructure economics and competition
key_risks: Datacenter/server replacement cycle and finance leases
AI infrastructure may absorb incremental CFO
Antitrust/enterprise customer concentration, cloud competition
Equity compensation and repurchases
MSFT.evidence_limit: No FY2027 Q1 results were yet due as of review date; management announcement for 28 Oct is future, not current actuals.

ADBE.sector: Software subscription / creative and document tools

evidence.fact: 9M FY2026 revenue $19.776bn and CFO $7.646bn; Aug 2026 ARR $27.50bn
evidence.impact: Subscription recurring revenue is material but ARR is not revenue, FCF or a GAAP valuation denominator

evidence.location: Note 10 — Stock-Based Compensation; Note 12 — Net Income Per Share
evidence.fact: 9M FY2026 stock compensation $1.584bn; unrecognized stock awards cost $4.03bn; basic outstanding 389.2m at 2026-09-18
evidence.impact: Basic count differs from treasury-stock diluted denominator; avoid treating basic count as fully diluted

evidence.location: Note 11 — Stock Repurchase Program; Note 3 — Business Combinations
evidence.fact: 9M FY2026 open-market share buybacks 26.1m shares for $6.820bn; Semrush acquisition referenced in financing and business combinations notes
evidence.impact: Reconcile issuance versus repurchases and economic acquisitions omitted from simple CFO-CAPEX

ADBE.business_quality: Profitable recurring software franchises with subscription base; competitive changes from generative AI need customer and pricing evidence
key_risks: Generative AI commoditization or growth reallocation
SBC, large authorizations and price paid for buybacks
Acquisitions and customer churn
Annualized 9M financials must not be treated as FY audited figures
ADBE.evidence_limit: 389.2m is the basic shares outstanding at a dated point, not a current fully diluted denominator.

evidence.location: Form 10-Q cover; Note 11 — Stockholders' Equity; Note 12 — EPS
evidence.impact: Share classes are not interchangeable one-to-one. Conversion and litigation adjustments required for an A-equivalent fully diluted count

evidence.fact: US litigation escrow $888m as of 2026-06-30; $2.977bn payments to opt-out/class merchants, $875m additional deposits; 9M CFO $16.342bn
evidence.impact: Separate settlement liabilities, escrow and trust restricted cash; do not capitalize unadjusted CFO as perpetuity

evidence.fact: Fiscal Q4/full-year 2026 scheduled for 2026-10-27 after market close

V.business_quality: Scale/network effects in global electronic payments, subject to regulation, client incentives, and cross-border volumes
key_risks: Interchange class actions and conversion protections
Price regulation, network competition and digital alternatives
Client incentive growth and gross-to-net revenue
Share class dilution and restricted escrow
V.evidence_limit: Current equity A-equivalent share denominator unresolved; per-share fair price should remain blocked.

MA.sector: Global payments network and value-added services

evidence.location: Form 10-Q cover; Note — Stockholders' Equity / Common Stock Activity
evidence.fact: 2026-07-27 common outstanding A 869,464,115 plus B 6,545,825, total basic counts 876,009,940 (arithmetical sum only); H1 shares repurchased 17.6m for $8.933bn
evidence.impact: Basic class sum does not adjust share-based awards or anti-dilutive securities; review class conversion terms

evidence.fact: H1 2026 CFO $6.772bn vs $6.983bn H1 2025; settlement obligations +$750m, accrued legal settlements -$504m, prepaid expenses -$3.835bn
evidence.impact: Business may grow while CFO moves with customer incentives and legal settlements; avoid direct annualization

evidence.fact: FY2025 net revenue $32.791bn; payment network $19.476bn and value-added services $13.315bn
evidence.impact: Separate take-rate and VAS growth with incentive economics; do not assume identical margins

MA.business_quality: Large global payment rails with growing value-added solutions; regulatory and merchant bargaining counterbalance network economics
key_risks: US and international antitrust/interchange litigation
Customer rebates, incentives and prepayments
Class B conversion/re-purchases and equity award dilution
Revenue growth may not translate 1:1 to distributable CFO
MA.evidence_limit: The 876.01m figure is an arithmetic sum of class basic counts, not current fully diluted outstanding shares.

evidence.location: Form 10-Q cover, operations and capital expenditures
evidence.fact: Q3 2026 revenue $6.055bn, EBIT $2.874bn, net $2.425bn; 913,770,316 basic shares outstanding as of 2026-10-14
evidence.impact: Current basic count != diluted share count; industrial cycle requires through-cycle margin/capex assumptions

evidence.fact: 9M FY2026 CAPEX $1.65bn vs $3.63bn prior; CHIPS Act cash proceeds $1.10bn as of 9M 2026
evidence.impact: Classify government receipts separately and avoid mixing GAAP CFO−CAPEX with adjusted management FCF

evidence.fact: Management reports LTM CFO ~$9.9bn and its own adjusted FCF ~$8.4bn including CHIPS Act incentive proceeds
evidence.impact: The definition adds CHIPS proceeds; not identical to plain CFO−CAPEX; demonstrate bridge before valuation

TXN.business_quality: Analog semiconductor economics with resilient industrial/auto product lifecycle but large fab commitments and cyclicality
key_risks: Factories and fixed-cost utilization sensitivity
Government subsidy timing and restrictions
Inventory turns / industrial and automotive cycles
Funding the fab program and capital returns through trough
TXN.evidence_limit: Current fully diluted shares remain unverified despite the recent basic cover count; LTM FCF reported is non-GAAP adjusted.
